name: Shadow Swap
hint: The bridge only shines while two friends stand on a plate. Take the light across first.
why4: The bridge needs weight 2 on a plate: two hold it while two cross and pile onto the far plate; a lone player on either side cannot hold it.
solution: P4 (in front) picks up the lantern at x=7.
P1 and P2 stand on the near plate at x=10-11: the bridge E over the 6-wide pit at x=16-21 appears.
P4 (lantern) and P3 cross the bridge. P3 jumps onto the plate on the 1-wide pillar at x=26 (height 1); P4 jumps onto P3's head (2/2).
P1 and P2 cross the bridge (P4's lantern lights its far end); then P4 and P3 hop down to the right.
P3 stands under the one-way shelf at x=34; P2 jumps off P3's head up through the shelf (height 3), touches the key and drops down.
Everyone jumps the 2-wide pit at x=38-39; P2 opens the door at x=44; all press Down.
Recovery: whoever falls in the big pit respawns at the start; the pair on the far side stacks on the pillar plate again to bring them over.
